name: Synthetic training TARA library (NOT real project data)
note: Illustrative, high-level patterns for demonstration only. Replace with your organisation's approved threat library.

patterns.name: Spoofed message injected on CAN
patterns.description: A message that appears to come from a legitimate sender is injected on the bus.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker gains access to the bus segment through a compromised node or physical access and transmits messages with a legitimate identifier.
patterns.damage: Receiving function acts on false data

patterns.name: Replay of captured CAN messages
patterns.description: Previously recorded valid messages are re-sent to trigger a function at the wrong time.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker records bus traffic and re-transmits it later.
patterns.damage: Function triggered at an unintended moment

patterns.name: Tampering with message content on CAN
patterns.description: Signal values in transit are altered.
patterns.attack_summary: A compromised gateway or bridge node modifies signal content between segments.
patterns.damage: Wrong data accepted by the receiver

patterns.name: Bus flooding denies CAN communication
patterns.description: High-priority message flooding starves legitimate traffic.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker with bus access transmits messages at very high rate.
patterns.damage: Loss of function that depends on the message

patterns.name: Tampering with Ethernet payload
patterns.description: Ethernet payloads are modified in transit between nodes.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker inserts a device into the network path.

patterns.name: Spoofed Ethernet node
patterns.description: A rogue node impersonates a legitimate Ethernet participant.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker connects an unauthorised device to a network port.
patterns.damage: False data or commands from an unauthenticated source

patterns.name: Denial of service on Ethernet
patterns.description: Excess traffic makes a service unreachable.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker generates high traffic volume towards a node.

patterns.name: Spoofed LIN command
patterns.description: A LIN slave accepts a command from an unauthorised master.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker with physical access to the LIN harness sends frames.

patterns.name: Unauthorised diagnostic session
patterns.description: Diagnostic services are used without proper authorisation.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker connects a tool to the diagnostic port and uses services that should be restricted.

patterns.name: Disclosure of data via diagnostics
patterns.description: Protected data can be read through diagnostic services.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker uses diagnostic read services without adequate access control.

patterns.name: No trace of diagnostic actions
patterns.description: Security-relevant diagnostic actions cannot be attributed.
patterns.attack_summary: Actions performed through the diagnostic interface are not logged.

patterns.name: Unauthorised firmware reflash via diagnostics
patterns.description: Modified software is loaded through the diagnostic interface.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker uses programming services with insufficient authorisation.

patterns.name: Malicious update image accepted
patterns.description: A manipulated update package is installed.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker manipulates the update package on the path from backend to vehicle or on the backend.
patterns.damage: Persistent compromise of one or more ECUs

patterns.name: Rollback to vulnerable software version
patterns.description: An older software version with known weaknesses is installed.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker replays a previously valid update package.

patterns.name: Update package disclosed in transit
patterns.description: Software contents are read by a third party.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker observes the download path.

patterns.name: Exploitation of a wireless service
patterns.description: A vulnerability in a wireless service allows unintended code or command execution.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker within radio range sends crafted input to the service.

patterns.name: Exploitation of a cellular service
patterns.description: A vulnerability in a remotely reachable service allows unintended code execution.
patterns.attack_summary: Remote attacker sends crafted requests to the vehicle.

patterns.name: Malicious file processed from USB
patterns.description: Crafted media triggers unintended behaviour.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker with physical access supplies a manipulated USB device.

patterns.name: Extraction of cryptographic keys
patterns.description: Keys are read from the component.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker with physical or logical access to the component attempts to read stored keys.
patterns.damage: All protections relying on the key are void

patterns.name: Tampering with configuration data
patterns.description: Calibration or configuration values are altered.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker modifies stored parameters through an exposed interface.
patterns.damage: Function behaves outside its intended range

patterns.name: Disclosure of personal data
patterns.description: Personal data is accessed by an unauthorised party.
patterns.attack_summary: Attacker obtains data stored in or transmitted by the component.

controls.name: Message authentication and freshness
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall verify the authenticity and freshness of '{asset}' using a message authentication code of at least [MAC_LENGTH_BITS] bits before processing the message.
controls.assumptions: Key management exists; the ECU has cryptographic capability (hardware or software).
controls.alternatives: Gateway filtering only (reduces exposure but does not authenticate); detection only via IDS.

controls.name: Intrusion detection
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall report a security event within [DETECTION_TIME_ms] ms when [ANOMALY_CRITERION] is observed on '{asset}'.
controls.assumptions: A security event collection path (e.g. to a central logger) exists.

controls.name: Gateway filtering and segmentation
controls.requirement_template: The gateway shall forward '{asset}' between network segments only if it matches the approved communication matrix.
controls.assumptions: A gateway separates the network segments; the communication matrix is maintained.
controls.alternatives: Flat network with host-based checks on each ECU.

controls.name: Rate limiting
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall limit the processing of '{asset}' to at most [MAX_RATE_PER_S] messages per second.

controls.name: Diagnostic access authentication
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall grant access to protected diagnostic services only after successful authentication using [AUTH_METHOD].
controls.assumptions: A key or certificate provisioning process exists for service tools.
controls.alternatives: Physically disabling the port in the field (loses service capability).

controls.name: Secure boot
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall verify the cryptographic signature of the software image before executing it.
controls.assumptions: A root of trust is available in hardware or immutable boot code.

controls.name: Signed update packages
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall install an update package only if its digital signature is verified against [TRUST_ANCHOR].
controls.assumptions: Backend signs packages with protected keys.

controls.name: Anti-rollback protection
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall reject an update package whose version is lower than the stored minimum version counter.
controls.assumptions: A non-volatile monotonic counter is available.

controls.name: Protected key storage
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall store cryptographic keys in [SECURE_STORAGE] that prevents extraction through external interfaces.
controls.assumptions: Secure hardware or a protected memory region exists.

controls.name: Input validation on external services
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall reject inputs to '{asset}' that do not conform to the specified format and length.

controls.name: Tamper-evident security logging
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall record [SECURITY_EVENTS] with timestamp and requester identity in tamper-evident storage.
controls.assumptions: Persistent storage and a time source are available.

controls.name: Protection of personal or confidential data
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall protect '{asset}' at rest and in transit using [ENCRYPTION_ALGORITHM].
controls.assumptions: Approved algorithms and key management exist.

controls.name: Physical access hardening
controls.requirement_template: The {component} shall reject '{asset}' frames whose sender is not [APPROVED_MASTER].
controls.assumptions: Harness routing limits access; network roles are defined.
